limitations: All product measurements use 6961e50b685d441e88b37d20d3f38a27136572fb; later commits change only performance harnesses and report generation.
Physical iPad web and native are P1/unmeasured because iOS 26 XCUITest requires a root-owned RemoteXPC tunnel that could not be started without an administrator credential.

iPad simulator native actions and landscape drawing are P1/unmeasured: the simulator Settings surface does not expose the persisted rotation-lock control required by ADR-0090. No external rotation or profiling-only preference seam was used.
Android physical and emulator landscape action sweeps are P1/unmeasured after repeated Settings-navigation timeouts. Valid drawing and undo evidence for those modes is retained.

Resolved campaign-harness P1s: desktop coloring scroll was changed to a trusted wheel path, the WebKit coloring-page readiness race was fixed, and Appium 3 borrowed screen/action sessions were made W3C-safe with explicit provenance. Exact post-fix retries completed; no product result was rerun merely to turn a valid red gate green.
Two Firefox action waits failed once at different labels and passed their exact retries, so they are retained as transient incidents rather than repeated P1s.

Firefox drawing is unmeasured because the real-screen frame runner supports Chromium and WebKit only. Standalone Mac undo-scenario captures are advisory and lack the per-mode metadata required by this matrix.

Desktop captures used exact 1512×982 or 982×1512 CSS viewports at DPR 2. The headed landscape browser window exceeded the physical display height at 100% browser zoom, but Playwright retained the requested page viewport.
Simulator, desktop, native-shell, and automated Android results are advisory. Physical iPad web is the only Safari-calibrated release-gate transport, and it was unavailable in this campaign.
Raw perf-profiles remain local scratch evidence; sources.json preserves their ordered provenance and data.json contains the committed normalized results.

preservedEvidence.reason: The 2026-08-20 campaign wrote its raw captures to gitignored perf-profiles scratch, and that scratch is no longer on the workstation, so those cells cannot be re-read from raw input. Their normalized results are carried forward from the published report rather than recaptured, which would replace a first valid result — including a red gate — with a different number.
